entities.summary: Siri Kolu (b. 1972-07-18, Kouvola) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kouvola and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, poets & playwrights, europe.
